name: Chía
registryCustodian: Instituto Geográfico Agustín Codazzi (IGAC), gestor catastral de Chía; Alcaldía Municipal de Chía as local administrative custodian/contact point
queryAndRequestOutcome: Separate English and Spanish discovery identified the official IGAC Colombia en Mapas cadastral viewer, an IGAC Chía-specific ArcGIS MapServer, and a CAR integrated cadastral MapServer. The Chía layer schema request timed out before response; the CAR layer request was blocked by TLS verification failure and was not retried with verification disabled. No safe anonymous parcel ID plus full polygon was obtained.
scopeLimits: Official municipal sources evidence IGAC custody and a Chía cadastral update, but do not provide an open parcel download in the reviewed pages.
The official IGAC service advertised in discovery could not be contacted within the bounded timeout; this is an availability limitation, not evidence of absent coverage.
The CAR endpoint was not queried past certificate verification failure; no TLS exception was authorized.
The exact WUP point [4.87517981020063, -74.050002621291] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
No sample GeoJSON was retained because no safe native identity and complete parcel polygon were verified.
sourceSpecificFields: No feature schema was retrieved. The official service metadata indicated ArcGIS MapServer/GeoJSON capability, but native parcel field names and any composite-key rules remain unknown.
qualification: Not qualified for runtime integration or admission. Serial review must independently verify a reachable official adapter route, safe field mapping, feature-level CRS, stable native identity, citywide coverage, and bounded geometry behavior.
uncertainty: Local custody is evidenced, but anonymous parcel geometry, schema, update cadence, and adapter robustness remain unverified. No credentials, private tokens, owner/address data, or unsafe fields were requested.
